question: Which cycles of knots feed themselves (the eddy rule against growth), and what are the minimal self-feeding loops to eight knots, their round-weights, ratios, behaviour under not-all-equal and interfaces?

forbidden_inputs: Changing the rule, a case, the catalogue or a prediction after reading any comparison; any miss is a failure, not a new exclusion
primary_observable: E1-E4, C1-C4, I1-I3, R1-R2, U1 of research/LOOP-CATALOGUE-20261119-001/preregistration.md

predictions.E1: rule-eddies exponential, exact ones equal the rule
predictions.C1: catalogue entries exponential, equal, NAE equal
predictions.C4: no algebraic entry to eight knots

stop_rule: One run; read-out; referee hand-off; report.
disclosed_exploration: pilot/ (census check, ~1M random starts at 6-12 knots, catalogue searches, smoke run), recorded in the pre-registration

amendments.text: 27 part-U shards (U-001 to U-037, listed in the run) exceeded 1,500 MB per case (peak 1,972 MB at failure). They are rerun by job_mem.py (same cases, code and caps; --param only=...) with 5 GB per case on 2 workers (LOOP-CATALOGUE-B2, runs/loop-catalogue-mem). No other case changed; no comparison was read before this amendment.

merge.py: the verdicts are cast to bool before printing (a numpy bool from R2's comparison could not be serialized). No rule, threshold or case changed; the merge had produced no output before this fix.

The memory rerun (B2) also exceeded 5 GB on its first shards and was stopped. The 27 part-U shards are rerun by job_iso.py: each start grown in its own child process limited to 3 GB of address space and 90 s, printing its counts after every round; a child stopped by the limit is recorded as 'over limit' with the counts it finished. Same starts, rounds and junction cap; the class rule is growth_class's, applied to the counts (B3, runs/loop-catalogue-iso).

merge_fixed.py adds, beside the frozen verdicts, the verdicts of merge.py with its three slips fixed: C2's 30-term W recomputed to 120 terms where it disagreed; I2's loop knots taken as the cycle's knots and the path of two's factor as the pre-registration's (1 + y)/(1 - y); R1's even rings compared by rate where W was left uncomputed. The frozen verdicts remain the record (8 of 14); the fixed ones are reported as post hoc.

amendments.kind: rerun after a machine-wide memory exhaustion
amendments.text: Between 07:19 and 07:45 UTC an unrelated job exhausted the machine's memory, and the OOM killer stopped children of B3; B3 recorded such kills as 'over limit'. B3 is stopped and superseded by B4 (runs/loop-catalogue-iso2): job_iso.py now tells its own limit (exit status 1, or the 90 s timeout) from a signal from outside (negative status), regrowing the child up to three times in the latter case. Same starts, rounds, caps and class rule.
